text:
anya: heads-up, saw a canary load fail: mmap path tried to map a gzipped safetensors shard and blew up.
jon: hmm. we have several assumptions in the mmap loader about contiguous offsets. did we get a compressed shard without a mapping sidecar?
anya: yep. uploader gzip flag flipped, no chunk map emitted. loader attempted direct mmap and hit invalid header.
sasha: scary but expected. i think we need a non-blocking probe step that decides whether to mmap, stream, or hybrid.
kevin: agree, probe must be cheap and cacheable. but think about p99 on coldstart — one extra metadata call could hurt.
zane: what if probe is asynchronous: start a tiny metadata fetch in parallel with index read; if index fails, switch to streaming without waiting.
jon: racey but elegant. default: optimistic mmap, then fallback to streaming if validateOffsets() fails. probe result can tune future loads.
anya: good. add a capability blob but make it optional: objectname.caps.{json,proto}. small schema: compression: none|gzip|zstd, mmap_friendly: true|false, chunk_map_version: int, signature_state: verified|absent|delegated, prefetch_ok: true|false.
sasha: plus a feature bit for "range_decompress_supported" so we know if the storage supports range+inflate server-side.
kevin: vendors differ. S3 won't do range-inflate, some proxies do. prefer a sidecar rather than relying on HEAD heuristics.
zane: cache keys should be model_hash + artifact_etag; TTL default 24h, override per-account for hot experiments.
jon: metrics we need: probe_calls, probe_cache_hit, fallback_to_stream, mmap_validation_failures, wasted_stream_bytes.
anya: QA: fuzz harness that mixes gzipped, zstd, partial header truncation, and intermittent sidecar presence. also a chaos job that toggles uploader gzip during continuous deploys.
sasha: runtime API change: BlobResolver.resolve(tensor) -> returns either a mmap_descriptor OR a ordered segment list (blob, start, len, compressed_hint). keep the union typed but serialized as short lists.
kevin: small security thing: never trust caps blob for mmap offsets unless binary signature validated. treat caps as advisory until signature verified.
zane: ops: add alert if fallback_to_stream > 3% for a model across an hour. add runbook "compression mismatch warmup" with steps: repro, examine .caps blob, uploader fix, force re-ingest.
jon: rollout: feature flag REDWOOD_STREAM_MMAP_HANDOFF=on for canaries, measure impact, then opt-in for accounts.
anya: i'll draft an RFC with example caps schema, resolver contract, metrics, tests, and migration checklist. anyone want to co-author?
sasha: i can help with tests and the hybrid resolver patch.
kevin: i'll own alerts and runbook.
zane: i'll update uploader CLI to optionally emit chunk maps and .caps blobs.
dev-bot: RFC created: /r/stream-mmap-handoff-probe (pinned in #eng-ml). :white_check_mark:
anya: thanks all, i'll post the RFC link and action items in the thread.
